# GB5's single-core section as SimPoints (tools/exp.sh with SET=sp runs them; tools/exp-table.py totals them).
# The basic-block vectors: simmerv-cli -n -m 2048 --insn-time 100 --mark-every 100M --bbv 50M:gb5.bbv
#   -d gb5.dtb,0x9ff00000 fw_payload.bin,0x80000000 img.Geekbench5.cpio,0x96270e00
# the subtests' instruction ranges from its console's "Running <subtest>" marks, and per subtest
#   tools/simpoint.py gb5.bbv --from <first> --to <last> --kmax 4
# A `range` line is a subtest's retired-instruction range; a `point` line one of its 50 M intervals:
# where it starts, its weight in the subtest, and its checkpoint (simmerv-cli --ckpt), taken 20 M
# instructions before the interval so a run warms for 20 M and measures 50 M.
